top_findings.title: Standings double-counts and splits teams, producing an incorrect Brasileirao table
top_findings.evidence: soccer_data.erl:7,11 loads BOTH Brasileirao_Matches.csv (label "Brasileirao") and novo_campeonato_brasileiro.csv (label "Brasileirao Historical"); seasons 2012-2019 overlap and contain the SAME physical matches (27/04/2019 Flamengo 3-1 Cruzeiro in both; each file has exactly 380 rows for 2019). The default standings competition "Brasileirao" (soccer_mcp.erl:13) is matched by a case-insensitive SUBSTRING filter (soccer_query.erl:15), so it matches BOTH labels and feeds 760 matches into the 2019 table. soccer_query.erl:45 add_table keys the table by the RAW team name, and the two files spell clubs differently ("Flamengo-RJ" vs "Flamengo"), so each team splits into two rows. _factual.json score 0.0.
top_findings.suggestion: Key standings by normalized team name and dedupe overlapping matches across the two Brasileirao files (or make the competition filter an exact-label match).

second_opinion.verdict: CONFIRMED — first evaluator was correct; R9 re-classified missing->partial, coverage unchanged at 0.9167
